query: WITH hg AS (SELECT sr.name AS series, c.id AS chapter_id, c.title AS chapter_title, c.description, c.is_active AS chapter_is_active, l.id AS lesson_id, l.title AS lesson_title, l.is_active AS lesson_is_active, l.content AS lesson_content FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels lv ON lv.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id LEFT JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id LEFT JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id WHERE lv.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND s.name='Histoire-Géographie'), per_series AS (SELECT series, count(DISTINCT chapter_id) AS chapters, count(lesson_id) AS lessons, count(lesson_id) FILTER (WHERE chapter_title='PREMIÈRE PARTIE — NOTIONS DE MÉTHODOLOGIE') AS methodology_lessons, count(lesson_id) FILTER (WHERE description='Discipline : Histoire' AND chapter_title<>'PREMIÈRE PARTIE — NOTIONS DE MÉTHODOLOGIE') AS history_lessons, count(lesson_id) FILTER (WHERE description='Discipline : Géographie') AS geography_lessons, count(lesson_id) FILTER (WHERE lesson_is_active IS TRUE) AS active_lessons, count(lesson_id) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(lesson_content,'')<>'') AS contentful_lessons, count(DISTINCT chapter_title) AS distinct_chapter_titles, count(DISTINCT chapter_title || '|' || coalesce(lesson_title,'')) FILTER (WHERE lesson_id IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_chapter_lesson_pairs FROM hg GROUP BY series), protected AS (SELECT sr.name AS series, s.name AS subject, count(DISTINCT c.id) AS chapters, count(l.id) AS lessons, count(l.id) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(l.content,'')<>'') AS contentful_lessons FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels lv ON lv.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id LEFT JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id LEFT JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id WHERE lv.name='Terminale' AND sr.name='A1' AND s.name IN ('Mathématiques','Philosophie') GROUP BY sr.name,s.name) SELECT 'histoire_geographie' AS audit_type, series, NULL::text AS subject, chapters, lessons, methodology_lessons, history_lessons, geography_lessons, active_lessons, contentful_lessons, chapters-distinct_chapter_titles AS duplicate_chapters, lessons-distinct_chapter_lesson_pairs AS duplicate_lessons FROM per_series UNION ALL SELECT 'protected' AS audit_type, series, subject, chapters, lessons, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, contentful_lessons, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint FROM protected ORDER BY audit_type, series, subject NULLS FIRST;
